email.subject1: a signal play for Higher Logic
email.body1:
Mark, saw Higher Logic launched Vanilla MCP to wire community data into AI tools and brought on a new Chief Community Officer.

Leaning into AI-powered community usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Higher Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mark, quick follow-up for Higher Logic.

As a CRO, you know a new AI direction spikes demand faster than headcount can absorb. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Higher Logic needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mark, last bit of proof for Higher Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Higher Logic's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mark, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority for Higher Logic this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right as you push the AI community direction, and I know that stretch is busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Higher Logic either way.
